content: Improves the Input Action System to correctly handle multiple touches originating on `UIButtons` and `UIModifiers`.
Improves memory-tracking system.
Updates `Player:IsVerified` API to accept verification level enum.
Adds type information for `Class.Player:GetCameraState()`.
Fixes a `FontFace` editing bug for `Class.InputActionLabel`.
Optimizations and stability improvements for Bone and Attachment-based rigs.

Adds `BatchGetAsync` to ordered data stores, allowing retrieval of multiple key-value pairs in a single request. Accepts an array of up to 100 string keys and returns a dictionary mapping each key to its value. Gated by `DataStoreEnableOrderedBatchGetAsync`.

Adds `Enum.PreferredInput.MicroGamepad|MicroGamepad` for when a player has connected or most recently interacted with a gamepad without a thumbstick (for example, a TV remote or another limited-input gamepad). Also adds `Enum.KeyCode.ButtonCenter|ButtonCenter`, `Enum.KeyCode.ButtonBack|ButtonBack`, `Enum.KeyCode.ButtonUp|ButtonUp`, `Enum.KeyCode.ButtonDown|ButtonDown`, `Enum.KeyCode.ButtonLeft|ButtonLeft`, and `Enum.KeyCode.ButtonRight|ButtonRight`.
Fixes various crashes related to physics constraints.
Fixes an issue where the MicroProfiler only showed local IP addresses when connecting to it.
Adds the `MemoryStoreDistributedCounter` data structure to the `MemoryStoreService` with support for `GetAsync()` and `IncrementAsync()` methods.
Adds min and max value controls to the `NumberSequence` editor in QT Properties.
Fixes an issue where equipping and unequipping tools sometimes caused full `FastCluster` (avatar rendering) rebuilds and framerate spikes.
Fixes an issue where user-defined type function instances were not evaluated for autocomplete.
Fixes mesh LOD flickering by transferring the cull handle instead of recreating it.
Fixes occasional cursor lock when the app starts in the background.
Fixes order-dependent logic when comparing attributes under server authority.
Scripts can now rename a player's Character model at any point in its lifecycle. The name lock that previously blocked renames without `WritePlayer` is no longer applied.
Fixes SLIM support for emissive maps in `Class.SurfaceAppearance` objects.
Fixes a bug where tables containing a `message` key were not fully output when passed to `error`.
Fixes a bug where exported type functions would sometimes be replaced with `**error-type**` or raise an error alluding to modification across arenas.
Fixes the `AccessOutsideWrite` capability for sandboxed `ModuleScripts`.
"Remove from list" no longer appears in the context menu of local files in the Experiences page.
